data.description:
# Tooltips in the end-of-turn ledger

## Problem statement

The end-of-turn ledger (the Turn Summary dialog) displays financial figures
without explaining how those figures were derived. Players see rows such as
`Business income: +42` or `Staff costs: -8` but have no way to understand how
the totals were computed, which businesses contributed, or what factors
influenced the amounts. This makes it hard to learn the economy or to plan the
next turn.

## Users

- **The human player** — needs to understand their turn's financial outcome to
  make strategic decisions for the next turn.
- **Competitive seats (AI/human)** — the per-seat tabbed panel should expose the
  same breakdowns for the selected seat.

### User stories

- _As a player, I want to hover over each ledger line to see a tooltip that
  explains exactly how that line is calculated, so I can understand my
  financial position._
- _As a player, when I hover over "Business income" I want to see a breakdown
  of each business owned and the amount coming from each, so I can understand
  where my income comes from._
- _As a player, when I hover over "Incident" I want to see which event caused
  it and what the effect was, so I can understand the impact._

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Every row of the Turn Summary P&L statement — each income line, each
   expense line, the Incident row, the One-off row and the Net profit/loss
   bottom line — displays an explanation tooltip on hover (desktop) and on tap
   (touch), using the shared `attachHudTooltipZone` / `tooltipManager` pattern.
2. The "Business income" tooltip (base/synergy/revenue income lines) breaks
   down each business owned, showing the business name and its individual coin
   contribution.
3. The "Staff costs" tooltip breaks down the cost of each individual staff
   card.
4. The "Community costs" tooltip breaks down the cost of each individual
   community space.
5. The "Business costs" tooltip breaks down the running cost of each individual
   business card.
6. The "Incident" tooltip shows the incident card name and describes its coin
   and reputation effect.
7. The "One-off" tooltip explains the source of the one-off adjustment (market
   purchases/sales, event plays, Community Favour, etc.), or, where a per-source
   breakdown is not available, the reconciliation formula that produces it.
8. The "Net profit/loss" tooltip explains the reconciliation formula:
   income + expenses + incident + one-off = net.
9. Supplementary context rows (reputation change, score change, closing coins,
   businesses owned) also display tooltips explaining their derivation.
10. Tooltip content is localisable via the existing i18n system (`t()` /
    `registerLocale`), with English defaults registered at module load.
11. Tooltips are non-blocking: they appear on hover/tap and dismiss on
    mouse-out/second tap without interfering with tab switching or the
    `[ Next Turn ]` / `[ Bank Loan ]` buttons.
12. Competitive closings render the same tooltips for the selected seat's tab.
13. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code
    comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
14. Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Impact

Players can now see exactly how every figure in the end-of-turn ledger is
calculated — which businesses earn the most, what costs drag them down, and
how incidents and one-offs affected the bottom line.

## Constraints

- Tooltips must be purely presentational: no new state mutations and no RNG
  consumption.
- Tooltips follow the existing visual style (dark background, gold accent for
  headings, readable font size) consistent with the Turn Summary dialog.
- No new accounting data invented by the UI: tooltips present figures the
  engine already commits (or expose an existing per-item breakdown), so the
  statement still reconciles to `TurnLedger`.
- The existing `TurnLedger`/`CompetitiveRoundLedger` shapes carry per-phase and
  per-category subtotals but not per-item detail; per-item data must be either
  threaded from the engine or derived from existing structures
  (`IncomeResult.breakdown`, `streetGrid` slots, `staffCards`, etc.).
- Reuse the shared tooltip helper rather than inventing a new tooltip widget.

## Existing state

- The ledger is rendered by `presentTurnSummaryPanel` in
  `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummaryOverlay.ts`. Rows are created by the
  `addLine` / `addHeading` helpers as non-interactive
  `Phaser.GameObjects.Text` objects.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary.ts` projects the committed ledger into a
  `PLProjection` (income lines, expense lines, incident/one-off adjustments,
  net bottom line, supplementary context) — currently `{ label, coins }`
  pairs with no per-item breakdown.
- Per-business income detail exists in `IncomeResult.breakdown`
  (`SlotIncome[]`: `businessName`, `baseIncome`, `synergyBonus`, `total`) and
  in `PhaseBreakdown.perSlotBreakdown` (`SlotPhaseBreakdown`).
- Per-item ongoing costs are computed per card in
  `applyStaffOngoingCosts` / `applyCommunitySpaceOngoingCosts` /
  `applyBusinessOngoingCosts` (`src/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts`), but only the
  family totals reach `TurnLedger.ongoingCosts`.
- The one-off delta is currently a residual
  (`netCoinChange - incomeCoins - ongoingTotal - incidentCoinChange`), with no
  per-source breakdown stored.
- The project already has an established tooltip system:
  `attachHudTooltipZone` (`core/src/ui/Renderer/index.ts`) drives
  `scene.tooltipManager` on hover/tap; `MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` builds HUD
  tooltip content with i18n; `MainStreetTutorialHints.ts` shows the DOM-based
  tooltip container pattern.

## Desired change

- Extend the Turn Summary model (`MainStreetTurnSummary.ts`) so each
  statement/context row can carry optional per-item breakdown data (business
  name → coins, staff card → cost, community space → cost, business → cost,
  incident name → effect, one-off source → coins).
- Add i18n keys and English defaults for the new tooltip titles/bodies,
  following `MainStreetHudTooltips.ts`.
- In `presentTurnSummaryPanel`, attach the shared tooltip helper to each
  `addLine` text object, building the content lazily from the model.
- Where the engine does not currently surface per-item detail (notably
  one-off sources), either thread the breakdown from the closing phase or
  present the reconciliation formula; document the choice.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummaryOverlay.ts` — attach tooltips to ledger rows
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary.ts` — add per-item breakdown fields to the
  model/projection
- `src/scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` — reference/owner for tooltip i18n keys
  and content builders (or a new sibling module)
- `src/MainStreetEngineTurnClosing.ts` — source of the ledger and (if extended)
  one-off/per-item attribution
- `src/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts` — per-card ongoing-cost helpers
- `src/MainStreetAdjacencyScoring.ts` — `SlotIncome` / `SlotPhaseBreakdown`
  income breakdowns
- `core/src/ui/Renderer/index.ts` — `attachHudTooltipZone` shared helper

## Related work

- **MS-0MW3O2O0V00042E5** – Out-of-actions dialog overlay with End Turn/Dismiss and enable checkbox (completed)
- **MS-0MUZK652V001L71C** – Player-facing win target consistency HUD tooltip help (completed)
- **MS-0MUDYQQ2E00913QN** – Synergy tooltip (completed)

### Repository file matches

- `docs/game/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` — mentions income, business, ledger, tooltip
- `docs/game/ux-visual-audio.md` — mentions tooltips, ledger, income
- `core/CHANGELOG.md` — mentions business, tooltip, income

## Risks & assumptions

- **Assumption:** The existing `TurnLedger` / `IncomeResult` structures already
  contain (or can cheaply expose) the per-item data needed for tooltips. If
  not, additional data must be threaded through from the engine.
- **Assumption:** "Every line" includes the supplementary context rows;
  tooltips there are explanatory, not per-item.
- **Risk — one-off detail:** the ledger stores one-off only as a residual, so a
  true per-source breakdown needs engine work. Mitigation: present the
  reconciliation formula if threading per-source data proves invasive.
- **Risk — competitive parity:** competitive closings use
  `CompetitiveRoundLedger`, whose per-seat detail may differ; tooltips must
  degrade gracefully when a breakdown is unavailable.
- **Risk — performance/clutter:** tooltips on many rows could feel heavy; build
  content lazily and keep hit areas tight.
- **Risk — mobile:** tap-toggle tooltips on a modal with buttons must not
  collide with button presses (use `tapToggle: false` where the object is
  already a button).
- **Scope creep:** richer analytics (charts, per-turn history) are out of
  scope; record extra ideas as linked work items rather than expanding here.

## Assumptions communicated to producer

- A hover+tooltip is the chosen interaction (matches existing HUD tooltips).
- Supplementary context rows are included in scope.
- One-off may fall back to a formula-based explanation if a per-source
  breakdown would require invasive engine changes.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q: "Should supplementary context lines (reputation change, score change,
  closing coins, businesses owned) also have tooltips?" — Answer (inferred from
  "every line"): yes; they get explanatory tooltips. Source: work-item
  description, MS-0MW6GZKZZ006PLLO. Marked assumption, not a blocking question.
- Q: "Should tooltips work on mobile (tap-to-show) or desktop-only (hover)?" —
  Answer: both, matching the existing `attachHudTooltipZone` hover/tap pattern.
  Source: `core/src/ui/Renderer/index.ts`.
- Q: "For the 'business costs' expense line, does each business incur ongoing
  costs, or is it a flat fee?" — Answer: per-business; each placed, unsold
  business card charges its own `ongoingCost` (less Cost Cutter reduction).
  Source: `applyBusinessOngoingCosts` in `src/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts`.
- Q: "Can a per-source one-off breakdown be shown?" — Answer: not from the
  current ledger (residual only); fall back to the reconciliation formula
  unless the producer wants engine-level attribution added. Source:
  `buildTurnLedger` in `src/MainStreetEngineTurnClosing.ts`. OPEN QUESTION if a
  true per-source breakdown is required.

data.description: Cards should be updated, during play, to show their current income/reputation changes. That is when a card recieves a staff bonus or a synergy bonus or any other modification to their base amounts this should be reflected in the card text.
data.title: Cards should represent the actual income and reputation changes

# Effort and Risk Report

## Effort Estimate

- **T-shirt size:** Medium
- **Three-point (PERT):** O=12.00h, M=21.00h, P=34.00h
- **Expected (E=(O+4M+P)/6):** 21.67h
- **Recommended (with overheads):** 27.67h
- **Range:** [18.00h — 40.00h]
- **Unit:** hours

### Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)

| # | Item | O (h) | M (h) | P (h) | Expected (h) |
|---|------|-------|-------|-------|-------------|
| 1 | Extend Turn Summary model with per-item breakdowns | 3.00 | 5.00 | 8.00 | 5.17 |
| 2 | Add tooltip content builders and i18n keys | 2.00 | 4.00 | 6.00 | 4.00 |
| 3 | Attach tooltips to ledger rows in overlay | 2.00 | 3.00 | 5.00 | 3.17 |
| 4 | Competitive per-seat parity | 1.00 | 2.00 | 4.00 | 2.17 |
| 5 | One-off formula fallback / reconciliation tooltip | 1.00 | 2.00 | 3.00 | 2.00 |
| 6 | Unit + browser tests for tooltips | 3.00 | 5.00 | 8.00 | 5.17 |


## Risk Assessment

- **Risk Score:** 7/25 — **Medium**
- **Probability:** 3.16/5 | **Impact:** 2.1/5

## Confidence

- **Confidence:** 74%
- **Unknowns:** Whether the producer wants a true per-source one-off breakdown (engine change) or a reconciliation-formula fallback.; Exact preferred tooltip wording and formatting.
- **Assumptions:** Existing TurnLedger and IncomeResult.breakdown contain or cheaply expose the per-item data needed.; Hover tooltip (with touch tap-toggle) is the chosen interaction, matching attachHudTooltipZone.; Supplementary context rows are in scope with explanatory tooltips.
